# SD13-E5 Ranger level 8 SECOND-favored-terrain selection fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Ranger level 8 identity as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It is the level-8 hybrid chassis baseline fixture with exactly two
# additional chosen selections, exercising the level-8 "2nd favored terrain"
# burden that the level-8 chassis slice deliberately deferred (verified
# independently against d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com: "At 8th level and
# every five levels thereafter, the ranger may select an additional favored
# terrain. In addition, at each such interval, the skill bonus and initiative
# bonus in any one favored terrain (including the one just selected, if so
# desired), increases by +2."):
#
#   choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_2:terrain:mountain
#     -- the additional favored terrain selected at the 8th-level interval,
#        mirroring choice:ranger_favored_enemy_2's open-ended recognition idiom
#   choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_bonus_increase_target:terrain:first
#     -- the one favored terrain whose skill/initiative bonus increases by +2
#        at this interval (the first, forest), mirroring
#        choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target's restricted-pair
#        idiom (terrain:first | terrain:second)
#
# Everything else carries over from the level-8 baseline fixture unchanged. No
# terrain-detection engine exists in this codebase, so neither terrain's bonus
# is ever applied to an Initiative or skill total; the fixture makes no such
# claim.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-ranger-level8-second-favored-terrain
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:ranger:8
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy:enemy:humanoid_orc
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_2:enemy:undead
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target:enemy:first
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style:style:archery
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat:feat:point_blank_shot
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat_2:feat:manyshot
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain:terrain:forest
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_2:terrain:mountain
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_bonus_increase_target:terrain:first
choice=choice:ranger_hunters_bond:form:bond
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
